$schema: Fork/branch dependency manifest for Py4GW multi-source sync strategy
$doc: Each source entry declares what exclusive content to pull and what shared files may need reconciliation.
Sources can be external forks OR branches on your own repo.
exclusive_paths: directories/files owned entirely by this source — pulled via git checkout, no merge needed.
core_touchpoints: shared upstream files this source may modify — these require intelligent merge via Claude Code.
widget_entries: widget files that serve as entry points (pulled like exclusive_paths but live outside the lib dir).
conflict_policy: 'prefer_upstream' (default) for external forks where upstream likely has newer fixes.
'prefer_source' for your own branches where you intentionally changed corelib files.
The sync script processes exclusive_paths with plain git, then hands core_touchpoints to Claude Code for review.

frenkey-derp.description: LootEx automated loot management + ItemHandling + Scripts
frenkey-derp.notes: The enum LootEx=999 and its no-op handler already exist upstream. If upstream stays current, core_touchpoints may need no action.

my-corelib-fixes.description: Example: your own branch with corelib changes
my-corelib-fixes.notes: Template entry. Set branch and core_touchpoints to your actual values. prefer_source means your branch wins on conflicts.

sync_options.claude_allowed_tools: Bash(git diff *),Bash(git log *),Bash(git show *),Bash(git add *),Bash(git status),Read,Edit,Grep,Glob
